entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for multi-level User, Session, and Agent state management. Available as a managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, it utilizes temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval to maintain context across interactions.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It employs a three-tier L0/L1/L2 loading system to achieve a 91% token reduction and features observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain provides a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed entity relationships and scoped data access for multi-tenant deployments. It differentiates itself by performing gap analysis to identify missing information within user queries.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine features a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication to sustain sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and user profiling through connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows that allow agent memory to learn over time. It supports integration with over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or native Python and Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a FastAPI-based library that enables reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversation history. It serves as the upstream library for Hermes self-hosted wrappers and supports managed, local, and Docker Compose deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This Elastic License 2.0 provider manages context as a git-like repository, offering version control features such as branching and merging for markdown context trees. It achieves sub-100ms performance through a 5-tier retrieval system and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database for local storage and sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system manages persistent memory using Qdrant, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and runs on local infrastructure including Redis and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts, including context bundles and traces, to assist agents with complex tasks. It employs outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to manage and improve context quality.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management by storing messages in a SQLite-backed system with FTS metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material without losing information.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It imports data from sources like Obsidian and GitHub, achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur is a shared memory layer that stores human-readable YAML engrams on local disks for multi-agent systems. It utilizes a hybrid search combining BM25 and local embeddings for retrieval via the Model Context Protocol.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates with Hermes through MCP and Claude Code hooks, employing hybrid retrieval including vector search and BM25.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes LLM inference by reordering and deduplicating blocks to enable prefix reuse. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saving up to 36% in tokens.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system built on SQLite with FTS5 search rather than vector databases. It offers a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recalled memory. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes agents. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd uses an anticipatory cache to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. This local-first system utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models to provide an MCP-native server with automated configuration.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory for coding agents by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, rendering data into files like AGENTS.md. It provides MCP-native support and a local-first vault using SQLite and FTS5 to reduce prompt tokens by 94%.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal. It automatically indexes codebases and multimedia while using edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces Hermes Agent prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard for tracking estimated token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to manage agent memory without external dependencies. It features a built-in 1-10 importance ranking system that prioritizes high-value memories during context prefetch and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This tool provides a Git-backed context layer that stores agent workflows and documents in plain Markdown files. It includes a migration workflow for importing chat history and offers standardized setup and execution commands across different agent adapters.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Designed as a pull-model episodic memory plugin, this project focuses on data integrity with a trace.jsonl audit log for all memory operations. It supports immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall and utilizes an on-demand summarizer.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox, offering tools for semantic search and state updates.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables AI agents to handle financial transactions using USDC and stablecoins across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana. It allows agents to pay for services or charge for API access with direct wallet settlement and zero fees.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin serves as a local capability index for scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations. It provides five native tools for searching and fetching knowledge, including support for automatic generation of tool routing notes.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports manual memory storage and advanced retrieval features like configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution prioritizes security with default AES-256-GCM encryption at rest. It offers flexible execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon and combines HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval methods for precise recall.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A within a codebase.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also includes automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based curation loop focuses on memory hygiene by identifying 'rot' and contradictions in Markdown-stored data. It uses a Git-backed directory for versioned memory and provides slash commands to propose evidence-cited diffs for user review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements subagent-driven development to execute engineering tasks autonomously through a structured workflow of brainstorming, planning, and test-driven development. It functions as a plugin for various coding agents and CLI tools to enforce rigorous software development methodologies.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that supports 26 CLI executables, including Hermes Agent, for live design iteration. It features a sandboxed iframe preview and exports artifacts into multiple formats such as HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agentic operations.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as an AI memory platform that builds self-hosted knowledge graphs to provide agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients in Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions and Mermaid text across 11 diagram presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure the accuracy of the generated visual artifacts.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. it includes a master router for protocol skills and adds a dedicated verification and dispute resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Compatible with Hermes and Claude Code, this tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate 62 distinct categories of detectable AI writing patterns. It supports multiple operational modes, including rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution and cross-pollination across agents like Hermes and OpenClaw using an Agentic Evolver. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and merging skills from different sources.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 50 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the Agent Plugins spec v1.0.0. It maintains state across sessions by storing data within the project's documentation folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,153 markdown-based skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It features broad integration support for platforms such as Slack, Telegram, Raycast, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows Hermes Agent and other coding tools to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and provides a 100-credit free tier for these operations.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose and generate new skills. It produces both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via integrated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses across various domains and identifies analysis blind spots alongside its findings.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides modular packages for Pydantic AI that support instructions, resources, and scripts through a remote registry. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and ensures type-safe support for the agentskills.io standard.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills transform rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs using Lite and Full complexity modes. The workflow includes a specialized spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to validate project documentation.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically synchronizes edits from source files back into the primary literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness manages long-running agents using Git-based storage for durable session logs and decision tracking. It organizes operations through Human, Supervisor, Lead, and Peer roles, requiring Herdr for agent startup and hosting.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts, specifically supporting CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. The project follows the Agent Skills specification and includes specialized modules for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides and configuration documentation for Hermes Agent specifically in Portuguese. It includes a collection of skills formatted in SKILL.md that adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image models and FLUX 3 video generation into agent workflows. The modules provide specialized support for cinematic inserts, product advertisements, and audio directing through API-linked prompting guidelines.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and developer discourse into version-pinned skills with full audit trails and provenance maps. It links instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits and requires Python 3.10 and Node.js 22 or higher.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers a Python client and CLI for installing reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It supports the AgentSkills specification and incorporates commerce features via TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery during long-running processes.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika provides a local-first workflow language that audits permissions, costs, and types before execution via a single Rust binary. It ensures accountability by generating hash-chained, tamper-evident receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, notes, calendars, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It features a guided setup script for secure HTTPS configuration using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token consumption. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The system is designed for resilience, offering graceful degradation if embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub serves as a community repository for browsing and installing skills, fully implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system where an agent manages design while the user completes tasks via a tap-based interface. It stores data locally using SQLite and connects to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial and integration analysis on agent code. It combines deterministic pre-scans from multiple linters with verified findings produced in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Fablize adapts verified procedures for task decomposition using mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine for state management and a systematic protocol for causal debugging.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI to facilitate tool-based skill loading and automatic directory registration.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This comprehensive lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network exploitation and forensics. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle CVE-driven tasks.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit provides session management to maintain memory between agent conversations and orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural and adversarial code reviews. It also includes specialized tools for worktree recovery, state drift detection, and skill scaffolding.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts using vhs or Playwright to generate optimized GIF files under 8 MB. It streamlines repository documentation by embedding these rendered GIFs directly into the project's README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs to detect and report drift. It ensures reliability by validating skills against runtime-specific profiles using CI-friendly exit codes.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This project enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, providing direct installation commands for discovered tools. It is designed to integrate with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project implements a self-improvement loop that analyzes session history to identify skill gaps and propose structured updates. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses across protocols such as Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2. It is built for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and agents like OpenClaw and Hermes.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This utility certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and interpreter selection for agents operating across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL. It ensures environment-specific path syntax and verifies existing project-compatible Python runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards, buying context, and settling payments where 85% of the bounty goes to the winning wallet.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and produces structured reports featuring core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers local, private OCR for PDFs and images alongside video-to-text extraction for Douyin and local files. It also supports an e-commerce studio for batch material generation with brand overlays.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms via an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and various development tools. It supports both open-source and unfree licensed software, offering a reliable way to manage agent dependencies within the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct hardware and user interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent in Termux environments on Android. The setup supports persistent memory, over 70 tools, and flexible backend connectivity through local Ollama models or cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging. It also enables automated workflows by supporting scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing users to define strict security policies for messaging and web searches.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows for persistent state through mounted home directories and supports building specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It includes a REST API, CLI, and MCP server, providing detailed per-agent metrics, cost tracking, and LLM budget caps.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix and systemd for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane for managing multiple Hermes instances through a single web application with RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting Ubuntu and Debian servers, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation. It is designed for production environments to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers to power specialized agents for sentiment, technical, and fundamental analysis. It includes a Portfolio Manager to handle final transaction approval and execution within financial trading workflows.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Designed for self-hosted orchestration, this tool governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. Users can interface with the system via a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and mobile-first web dashboard to manage multiple coding agents, featuring swipe-to-approve tool calls. It supports agent sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers while integrating with git worktrees for parallel branch management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and can detect HTTP signals to manage payment-required states for paid APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms using over 23 LLM providers. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control platform allows users to supervise and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a single screen. It features a Kanban board for task tracking, live streaming of agent reasoning, and human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure domains. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Built on Hermes Agent profiles, this web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local communication and tool handling, providing a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents competing as two separate AI companies. The system uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for visualizing code, tasks, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for fully-local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080 without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It automatically synchronizes its index on every file change and supports languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents and IDEs, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a web-based visualization frontend and supports data submission for public profiles and leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer designed to inspect API traffic from various coding agents while redacting common authentication headers. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions, supporting tools like Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Gemini.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better UIs with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, and is compatible with any provider supporting markdown.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading agent states directly from CLIs like Hermes and Claude Code. It supports multi-device synchronization and displays historical usage trends broken down by session.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes and ASCII art. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify banner colors and spinners, offering aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via the Model Context Protocol. It includes a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and provides an undo functionality for recent changes made by the agent.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform enables a social economy for autonomous agents through encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, including a plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall. It also offers chat bot integrations for platforms such as Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and DevOps, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while managing specific skills and custom instructions at the directory level.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with zero cost, supporting 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed for AI agent configurations that performs local, deterministic checks on tool descriptions and system prompts. It identifies overlapping descriptions or inconsistent schemas and integrates with GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks using SARIF output.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool monitors multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for wake words and 35 languages. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality while requiring no API keys or external accounts.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed to help users generate revenue online, this project operates as a local-first skill utilizing dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime. It ensures safety by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations performed by the agent.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It centralizes configuration management for Hermes Agent alongside other command-line tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local coworking application that integrates Hermes Agent with 21 professional assistants specialized in document and spreadsheet creation. It extends agent functionality to remote environments through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface offers a lightweight way to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote connections through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This companion application simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a dedicated graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one desktop environment.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This comprehensive dashboard manages five agent runtimes and unified configurations across ten platforms, including Discord and Slack. Users can build executable visual workflows featuring loops, approval gates, and detailed tool traces.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized managers for skills and memory.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from multiple agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for system repair. It includes specialized native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a built-in kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated controls for MCP tools and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium extension integrates Hermes Agent directly into the browser side panel for site-aware drafting across 31 writing environments. It enables live browser control with explicit approval gates to ensure user oversight of agent actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive self-hosted Hermes agents from an iPhone. It facilitates real-time chat, task management, and file browsing via secure HTTPS or Tailscale connections.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and features custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, as well as a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and ZOO Swarm kanban pipelines. It features a browser-based terminal, real-time chat with tool call visualization, and a dedicated status panel for monitoring agent health and system metrics.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that aggregates searchable history from fifteen coding agent sources locally without telemetry. It functions as an agent cockpit for tracking live per-session quota burn and costs for Codex and Claude models.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface enables one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote workspace management.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that trigger side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management alongside tools for configuring profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. The interface includes a terminal chat with streaming responses and uses HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 for Telegram authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop application requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to provide a GUI for local and cloud AI models. It features a dynamic tool maker for Python handlers and supports workflows involving ComfyUI, TTS, and music generation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that combines real-time log streaming with a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It provides integrated management tools for organizing skills, cron jobs, MCP servers, and files.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard focuses on process transparency by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only views of environment configurations.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring tool approval cards and isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering and installing new skills and MCP servers.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated one-click installations and supports real-time model switching.
